inputs.share_count_basis: 1,135.9m = weighted-average ordinary shares in issue for H1 FY2026 (Interim Report 2026 note 7, RMB'000 table line 1259; treasury shares excluded). Share options and share awards were out-of-the-money and anti-dilutive in both H1 FY2026 and H1 FY2025, so basic = diluted. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows (and is immaterial), buybacks are small (RMB26m FY2025, RMB130m H1 FY2026) and are treated as value-neutral.
inputs.interest_income_note: Hengan earns ~RMB686m/yr of interest (FY2025) on RMB27.8bn of deposits, but NONE of it is inside reported OCF/FCF: the OCF reconciliation reverses 'Interest income and other finance income (686,073)' out of profit (Annual FY2025 line 5845) and 'Interest received 426,046' is classified in investing (line 5888). Deducting it again from reported FCF would double-strip, so interest_income is 0 here; the income IS excluded from the forward EBITDA path (see notes) and the matching asset (net cash RMB6.41bn) is added once in the bridge. Interest paid on the matching borrowings sits in financing and is likewise excluded.
inputs.sbc_source: Annual FY2025 cash flow statement, 'Equity-settled share-based payment' RMB146k (line 8594) plus share-based payment in employee costs RMB230k (line 11411); CSV StockBasedComp 2.513m. No equity-award tax withholding disclosed (EquityAwardTaxes 0 all years). SBC is 0.01% of revenue: an SBC-zero market in practice, charged at 0.0% forward with the line kept explicit.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 'Repurchase of treasury shares' RMB25.7m; H1 FY2026 RMB130.3m. Dividends are the cash-return mechanism: RMB1.40/share (RMB0.70 interim + RMB0.70 final), ~RMB1,594m/yr, i.e. 70% of FY2025 owner FCF and 105% of FY2024's.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and all flows in RMB (CNY); HKEX quote in HKD. Per-share values computed in CNY and converted at CNYHKD=X 1.1722 (Yahoo Finance, 2026-10-11). No dual listing for a parity check; cross-check: the RMB0.70 interim dividend converts to HK$0.82, consistent with the HKD dividend magnitude the company pays. refresh_price.py does not move fx_rate; re-check the rate on any later price-only refresh.
inputs.net_cash_note: 30 June 2026 (Interim Report 2026 balance sheet): cash and bank balances 22,187.5 (of which bank time deposits 15,314.2 and cash equivalents 6,873.2) + long-term time deposits 5,645.5 + restricted deposits 0.3 = 27,833.3 liquid; borrowings 21,169.8 current + 219.5 non-current = 21,389.3, plus lease liabilities 30.5 = 21,419.7 total debt. Net cash 6,413.6 (company states RMB6.44bn ex-leases, net gearing -29.4%). The gross position is a treasury carry trade (RMB5bn of 1.68-1.81% super-short-term CP issued in H1 FY2026 against higher-yielding RMB time deposits, hedged with FX forwards/options); only the NET cash is credited and neither the interest income nor the interest cost nor the derivative gains are in the flows. Not credited: equity-method investments RMB31m, investment properties RMB203m, derivative assets RMB216m (hedges of the borrowings).
inputs.wacc_rationale: CNY-denominated flows discounted at 9.0%. Build: China 10y CGB ~1.8% risk-free + ~6.5% China ERP x beta ~0.9 (branded consumer staple) + ~1.5% HK-listed-China governance/liquidity premium = ~9%; no debt in the capital structure on a net basis so WACC = cost of equity. Same rate in all three scenarios: cyclicality (pulp), share loss and the dividend-cover question are charged in the scenario flows and weights, not in the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: (A) leases as debt: lease liabilities RMB30.5m (11.5 non-current + 18.9 current, 30 June 2026) included in total_debt; lease principal (RMB22m/yr) NOT deducted from the flows; D&A includes right-of-use depreciation (RMB57m FY2025, mostly PRC land-use rights). Immaterial either way.
inputs.nci_treatment: Consolidated flows; non-controlling interests (RMB212.6m book at 30 June 2026) deducted once in the equity bridge. NCI's profit share is ~0 (FY2025 -RMB1.9m, H1 FY2026 RMB8.7m), so attributable-only flows would give the same answer.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing: operating company, non-US consumer, with the adaptations file applied for currency, leases, NCI, excluded income and the SBC-zero market). First valuation of this ticker; no memory entry. EBITDA DEFINITION: the CSV's FY2025 EBITDA of RMB4,535m (operating profit + D&A) includes RMB1,094m of 'other income and other gains': RMB615m deposit interest, RMB304m derivative gains, RMB189m government grants and sundry. The model's owner EBITDA is segment profit less unallocated costs plus D&A plus government grants (recurring municipal incentives, RMB190m FY2025 / RMB465m FY2024) and EXCLUDES deposit interest and derivative gains, whose source asset is the net cash in the bridge: FY2025 = 2,433.5 - 43.1 + 1,051.0 + 189.5 = RMB3,631m = 15.7% of revenue (cross-check: 'operating profit before working capital changes' RMB3,681m less realised derivative gains RMB282m = RMB3,400m ex grants). H1 FY2026 on the same basis was 17.0% (H1 FY2025 15.2%) on gross margin 35.3% (+3pp, pulp easing + premium mix) despite revenue -6.1%. FY0 NOPAT on this basis (~RMB2,010m at 22% tax) ties to reported attributable profit RMB2,535m less after-tax non-operating items (~RMB490m) within 2%. CASH TROUGH: H1 FY2026 OCF of RMB618m (vs 1,625m) is a RMB1.0bn trade-payables unwind (3,103 -> 2,104) plus seasonal weakness, not a margin event; the base case anchors on FY2025 owner FCF (RMB2,278m) and the component build, not on H1 annualised. REVENUE: flat since FY2019 (22.5bn -> 23.1bn); FY2024 -4.6%, FY2025 +1.8%, H1 FY2026 -6.1% with all three segments down (hygiene -2.8%, tissue -5.9%, others -14.9%). Management gives no numeric guidance; it says 'gross profit expected to remain stable' and 'sustaining stable overall profitability' for H2 FY2026. DIVIDEND COVER: RMB1.40/share (~RMB1,594m) was 105% of FY2024 owner FCF and 70% of FY2025's; the base-case flows (~RMB2.2-2.3bn) cover it 1.4x, the bear case barely covers it from ~FY2028, so the bear case implies either a cut or continued funding from the RMB6.4bn net cash. SANITY: at the price in current_price, market cap (1,135.9m shares, converted at fx_rate) is ~RMB18.9bn; less RMB6.4bn net cash plus RMB0.2bn NCI gives EV ~RMB12.7bn, i.e. ~5.6x FY2025 owner FCF and ~3.5x owner EBITDA; trailing P/E 7.5x; dividend yield 8.4%.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: equity_5yr_cagr (2.3%) haircut to ~1% because revenue has compounded at 0.6% for five years and H1 FY2026 was -6.1%; used as the long-run (FY2028+) base-case growth anchor, with the first two forecast years judged from the H1 run-rate
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR (+2.3%) diverges by more than 30% from EPS 5yr CAGR (-10.4%) and owner-FCF 5yr CAGR (-11.8%): book value compounds only because retained earnings exceed the dividend, while earnings power fell from the FY2020 peak (EBITDA margin ~32% on the CSV basis) to ~16% owner EBITDA as tissue prices, promotional intensity and pulp costs compressed margins. The 3yr figures (EPS +10.4%, FCF -3.0%) start from the FY2022 pulp-spike trough and overstate the trend.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are on the owner-FCF series (reported FCF less SBC; interest was never inside reported FCF under Hengan's cash-flow presentation). SBC is 0.01-0.3% of FCF in every year, so adjusted and reported CAGRs are within 1pp; SBC is not a growth-quality issue here. Windows: FY2020->FY2025 (5yr), FY2022->FY2025 (3yr). Revenue 22,374 -> 23,069 (5yr), 22,616 -> 23,069 (3yr); EPS 3.864 -> 2.227 and 1.657 -> 2.227; equity 19,411 -> 21,752 and 19,524 -> 21,752; owner FCF 4,276 -> 2,278 and 2,499 -> 2,278.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 -4.5%: H1 was -6.1% against a soft H1 FY2025 comp; H2 FY2025 (+4.0% YoY) is a tougher comp but consumption-subsidy policy and the new premium launches (Petite Warm Heart napkins, Embracing Nature tissue) should narrow the decline. FY2027 -0.5% as the hygiene share loss slows; then 1-2%: volume flat, price/mix low single digit, consistent with a 0.6% five-year revenue CAGR and management's 'stable growth in the long run'.
base.margin_rationale: Owner EBITDA 15.7% FY2025, 17.0% H1 FY2026. FY2026 16.3% assumes H2 gives back part of H1's pulp/mix gain to the usual H2 promotional weighting; 16.0% held thereafter: premiumisation and procurement scale offset tissue price competition and the mix drag from a shrinking hygiene segment. No re-expansion toward the 22-27% core margins of FY2019-21 is assumed.
base.capex_da_rationale: Capex 4.2% of revenue FY2025 (RMB961m) and 4.2% annualised H1 FY2026 after the FY2022-24 capacity build (5.5-6.8%); D&A 4.6% (RMB1,051m incl. RMB57m ROU and RMB32m intangibles). Modelled capex 4.3-4.4% converging on D&A 4.5%: maintenance-level spend for a mature, flat-volume manufacturer.
base.tax_rationale: Effective tax rate 21.0% FY2025 (RMB672m on PBT 3,205m), 23.2% H1 FY2026; cash tax paid RMB538m (lower on timing). Blend of 25% PRC statutory, 15% high-tech subsidiary rates and the 5-10% withholding tax on dividends repatriated to the Cayman parent (deferred tax liability RMB200m). 22% flat on EBIT.
base.wc_rationale: Manufacturer/distributor: inventories 4.4bn + trade receivables 2.1bn + other receivables 1.6bn against trade payables 2.1bn + other payables 2.0bn = ~RMB4.0bn net working capital, ~17% of revenue. Capture -12% of the revenue CHANGE (growth consumes cash; the FY2026 decline releases ~RMB120m). H1 FY2026's RMB1.0bn payables unwind is treated as timing, not a structural shift.

bull.rationale: H1 FY2026's 17.0% owner EBITDA margin holds and extends to 18.5% by FY2029 as premium series (Q-MO, Tianshan Cotton, Fluffy Cube, oriental cotton napkins) lift mix, tissue industry consolidation ends the price war and domestic pulp capacity keeps costs benign; hygiene stabilises in FY2027 and the group grows 3-3.5% for several years on consumption-upgrade policy and rural/online channel gains. Still well below the FY2019-21 core margins, so no heroic re-rating of the franchise is assumed.

bear.rationale: The H1 FY2026 decline is structural, not cyclical: the high-margin hygiene (sanitary napkin) franchise keeps losing share to new domestic brands after the 2024 industry quality controversy and to e-commerce-native entrants, tissue stays in a price war with private label, a pulp/petrochemical spike (Middle East oil) reverses the H1 gross-margin gain, and promotional spend rises to defend shelf. Revenue falls to ~RMB19.7bn by FY2030 and owner EBITDA settles at 13%. Owner FCF of ~RMB1.5bn no longer covers the RMB1.6bn dividend, so the payout is cut or funded from the net cash pile; terminal growth 0.5%.

scenario_narratives.base: Hengan is a mature, cash-generative Chinese hygiene and tissue franchise whose revenue has been flat for six years and whose core margin has halved since FY2020. The base case takes the H1 FY2026 top-line decline (-6.1%) as mostly cyclical (weak consumption, destocking, hygiene share loss slowing), lets FY2026 finish -4.5% and FY2027 flat, then grows 1-2% on price/mix. The owner EBITDA margin holds at 16% (FY2025 15.7%, H1 FY2026 17.0%): pulp stays benign and premium mix offsets tissue competition. Capex runs at maintenance (~4.4%) and owner FCF of ~RMB2.2-2.4bn/yr covers the RMB1.6bn dividend 1.4x. Value is the flows plus RMB6.4bn of net cash; the market price capitalises the operating business at ~5.6x owner FCF.
scenario_narratives.bull: Premiumisation works: the Q-MO / Tianshan Cotton / Fluffy Cube series and the new oriental-cotton napkins lift mix, tissue consolidation and domestic pulp supply keep gross margin at or above 35%, consumption-promotion policy and rural omni-channel penetration return the group to 3-3.5% growth from FY2028, and owner EBITDA reaches 18.5%. Dividend cover rises toward 1.8x and the balance-sheet cash becomes surplus to be returned.
scenario_narratives.bear: The decline is structural: sanitary napkin share keeps leaking to new domestic brands, tissue remains a commodity price war, a pulp/oil spike undoes the H1 FY2026 margin gain, and promotional spend rises to defend shelf. Revenue compounds negative to ~RMB19.7bn by FY2030 and owner EBITDA settles at 13%. Owner FCF (~RMB1.5bn) falls below the RMB1.6bn dividend, forcing a cut or a run-down of the net cash; the treasury carry trade (RMB21bn gross borrowings against RMB28bn deposits) becomes a governance question rather than a yield enhancer.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30%: revenue has fallen in two of the last three years and -6.1% in H1 FY2026 with all three segments down, the highest-margin segment (hygiene) is the one losing share, and the dividend already exceeded owner FCF in FY2024. Bull cut to 20% because it needs three independent things to go right at once (premium mix, tissue price discipline, benign pulp) after six years in which none of them produced growth. Bear is not 35%+ because there is no solvency or covenant risk: RMB6.4bn net cash and ~RMB1.5bn of trough FCF make the downside a slower-shrinking annuity, not a distress case.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value Hengan as a flat-to-slowly-shrinking consumer-staples annuity: owner FCF built from a 16% owner EBITDA margin that excludes the treasury income (deposit interest, derivative gains) whose source asset is credited once as net cash; no margin re-expansion toward the FY2019-21 levels; 9% CNY cost of equity with the China/hygiene-share-loss risk carried in a 30% bear weight rather than stacked onto the discount rate; terminal value capped at 15x FCF. The gap between the model and the price is the market's discount for Chinese consumer exposure, the gross-debt carry trade and the question of whether the RMB1.40 dividend survives.
key_risks_to_valuation: Hygiene (sanitary napkin) share loss accelerates: it is the highest-margin segment and its segment profit fell 12.6% in FY2025 and its external revenue 2.8% in H1 FY2026.
Tissue price war / private label keeps the largest segment (60% of revenue) at low-20s gross margin; FY2025's recovery in tissue segment profit (RMB265m -> 652m) may not hold.
Pulp and petrochemical input costs: a spike (Middle East oil, import pulp) reverses the +3pp H1 FY2026 gross-margin gain; FY2022 shows the sensitivity (EBITDA margin fell ~10pp).
Dividend sustainability: RMB1.6bn/yr exceeded FY2024 owner FCF and is only 1.4x covered in the base case; a cut would likely de-rate the stock even if intrinsic value is unaffected.

Treasury carry trade: RMB21.4bn of gross borrowings (RMB5bn of 180-day CP) against RMB27.8bn of deposits and FX derivatives; a funding-market or RMB shock could strand the structure even though net cash is RMB6.4bn.
Government grants (RMB190-465m/yr) are inside the EBITDA base; their discontinuation is ~0.8-2pp of margin.
Currency: value is in CNY and quoted in HKD; a 5% CNY depreciation moves the HKD value 5% before any operating change.
